description: This Java class 'FileBasedAuthenticationService' implements an authentication service that reads user and role permissions from a JSON file resource. It loads permissions on startup, parses roles and users, and provides methods for verifying user credentials (plain and external), and generating authentication tokens with associated authorities.

classes.name: FileBasedAuthenticationService
classes.description: A final class implementing a file-based authorization mechanism, extending 'AbstractHonoAuthenticationService' with specific logic to load user and role permissions from a JSON resource, verify credentials, and generate tokens.

methods.name: setConfig
methods.description: Sets the specific configuration properties for the authentication service.

methods.name: setTokenFactory
methods.description: Injects the token factory used to create authentication tokens.

methods.name: doStart
methods.description: Initializes the service by loading permissions; fails startup if token factory is not set or permissions cannot be loaded.

methods.name: loadPermissions
methods.description: Loads and parses permissions data from the configured resource path.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Reads data from a resource into a StringBuilder object.

methods.name: parsePermissions
methods.description: Parses permissions JSON object, delegating to role and user parsing methods.

methods.name: parseRoles
methods.description: Parses roles from JSON array, mapping role names to authorities.

methods.name: parseUsers
methods.description: Parses user entries from JSON object into internal user map.

methods.name: getUser
methods.description: Retrieves user JSON object for given id and mechanism if matching.

methods.name: getAuthorities
methods.description: Constructs authorities object based on user's roles.

methods.name: toAuthorities
methods.description: Converts a JSON array of authorities definitions into Authorities object.

methods.name: hasAuthority
methods.description: Checks if user JSON object has specified authority role.

methods.name: isAuthorizedToImpersonate
methods.description: Determines if user has authority to impersonate others.

methods.name: verifyPlain
methods.description: Verifies credentials presented in plain text, creates user token if successful.

methods.name: verifyExternal
methods.description: Verifies external (e.g., certificate-based) credentials, creates token if successful.

methods.name: verify
methods.description: Core method to generate a token for a verified user, potentially impersonating another.
